```sql
WITH tenant_customers AS (
    SELECT c.id,
           c.email,
           c.company,
           c.country_code
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
),
order_stats AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)           AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
      JOIN tenant_customers tc ON tc.id = o.customer_id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT tc.id,
       tc.email,
       tc.company,
       tc.country_code,
       os.revenue,
       os.order_count,
       os.last_order_at
  FROM order_stats os
  JOIN tenant_customers tc ON tc.id = os.customer_id
 WHERE os.last_order_at >= %(from)s
   AND os.last_order_at <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY os.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De herschrijving filtert eerst op de klanten van de tenant en aggregeert de orders per klant in één pass, waardoor de materialisatie, de DISTINCT ON-sortering en de extra join verdwijnen. Het resultaat is gelijk aan het origineel, omdat `max(created_at)` dezelfde waarde oplevert als de DISTINCT ON-selectie. Bij gelijke omzetten blijft de volgorde onbepaald, zoals ook in het origineel.
